title: Add --json output
body: Scripts need machine-readable output. `tallyho --json FILE...` should print one JSON object per file plus a total.

title: Add --top N most frequent words
body: Show the N most frequent words of each file, case-insensitive, ties broken alphabetically.

title: Binary files are counted as text
body: Running tallyho on a PNG prints nonsense word counts. It should skip binary files with a warning on stderr.

title: Read defaults from ~/.tallyhorc
body: Let users set default flags in a config file. Unclear whether the file should be shell or key=value.
